Players Committee card image of [[Bestoon Legacy]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “May add 2 pilots and 3 passengers. During your control phase, may peek at the top card of your Reserve Deck; may place it on Used Pile (if card is an assassin, may take it into hand).” Uploaded unchanged.
